sheets.title: Settings › Vaults › Item types, 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Before: the panel's own Visual/Source toggle sits over an always-open paste box, then a list of the 23 built-ins, each with a remove key that does nothing because a built-in cannot be removed. After: flat Installed and Marketplace tabs. Installed lists settings/item-types/installed/*.json; the built-ins are folded under builtin/, read-only, each with a key that opens its file.
sheets.before: panel controls: Visual/Source toggle + paste box; remove keys on built-ins: 23 (all no-ops)
sheets.after: tabs: Installed, Marketplace; remove keys on built-ins: 0; paste boxes: 0

sheets.title: Marketplace, 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: New. marketplaces.json lists ours by default: github.com/tyler-r-kendrick/OpenSesame@main. Opening the tab reads its .opensesame/marketplace.json; nothing is read before that. Each offer row leads with the extension it will wear in the vault tree and carries inspect and install keys. Any GitHub, GitLab, Gitea/Forgejo/Codeberg or Bitbucket repository, or a raw index address, can be added.
sheets.before: marketplaces: none (no way to find a type)

sheets.title: Inspect, then install, 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Inspect opens the offer's fields, with concealed ones locked, before install does anything. Installing writes settings/item-types/installed/vehicle.json through the same parser and registry as any other write. The row then shows the installed glyph, and the head count moves to 1 installed.

sheets.title: The source view is a file viewer, 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Opening marketplaces.json from its row switches Settings to its source view with that file open. The view is a file tree beside the open file: settings/vaults.yaml, item-types/marketplaces.json, installed/ (with + for a new file) and builtin/. The Form and this file are the same bytes.
sheets.before: no file behind the panel to open (the Form stays); source view files: 1 (settings/vaults.yaml)
sheets.after: source view files: 25 before the install (vaults.yaml, marketplaces.json, 23 built-ins); vehicle.json after

sheets.title: An installed type is a file, 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: installed/vehicle.json is the authored definition the vault body keeps. Save runs the parser; the trash key uninstalls (armed in place; items keep their values). Built-in files open read-only with a lock glyph and no save key.
sheets.before: no file behind an installed type
sheets.after: installed/vehicle.json: save + remove keys; builtin/*.json read-only

sheets.title: Settings › Vaults on a phone, 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, the Settings column grew to its widest child (the tab strip), so every panel ran past the right edge and was clipped. After, the section grid is minmax(0, 1fr): the tab strip scrolls itself and the Item types panel ends inside the 16px gutter.
sheets.before: Item types panel right edge 462px in a 390px viewport (clipped)

sheets.title: Marketplace on a phone, 390 × 844
sheets.caption: At phone width the actions drop under each row's text, so no key is clipped. Every key keeps its 44px target.
sheets.after: source row and offer rows: keys wrap under the text; 44px keys

sheets.title: The file viewer on a phone, 390 × 844
sheets.caption: On a phone the tree sits above the open file. Directories are indented a step per level, selection is inverse video, and every row is a 44px target.
sheets.after: file tree above the open file; 44px rows
